answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent must answer a beacon challenge fast, proving live computation; its quartz clock makes checks unpredictable. Missing two checks forfeits a 20-unit deposit; like timber, an unchecked identity bears no weight. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50,000 units per round at 50 each, more than rewards pay. Honest agents pay once, keep an undiluted share, and may wander on one heartbeat.
